arxiv-1511-01389.title: Effect of width, amplitude, and position of a core mantle boundary hot spot on core convection and dynamo action
arxiv-1511-01389.creator: WWieland Dietrich, JJohannes Wicht, KKumiko Hori
arxiv-1511-01389.description: Abstract Within the fluid iron cores of terrestrial planets, convection and the resulting generation of global magnetic fields are controlled by the overlying rocky mantle. The thermal structure of the lower mantle determines how much heat is allowed to escape the core.

arxiv-1712-05177.title: Single gene dynamics under controlled
arxiv-1712-05177.creator: mating
arxiv-1712-05177.description: Abstract Abstract We seek models for the genotype evolution of agricultural animals, animals involved in primary production processes. Classical models for genotype evolution have tended to be very simple in order that analytic methods may be employed in their study. Unfortunately these models fail to describe processes in artificially controlled populations including agricultural livestock.

arxiv-2102-11536.title: Explicit high-order generalized- α \alpha methods for isogeometric analysis of structural dynamics Journal: Arxiv
arxiv-2102-11536.creator: Pouria Behnoudfar, Gabriele Loli, Alessandro Reali, Giancarlo Sangalli, Victor M. Calo
arxiv-2102-11536.description: Abstract We propose a new family of high-order explicit generalized- α \alpha methods for hyperbolic problems with the feature of dissipation control. Our approach delivers 2 ​ k , ( k ∈ ℕ ) 2k,\,\left(k\in\mathbb{N}\right) accuracy order in time by solving k k matrix systems explicitly and updating the other 2 ​ k 2k variables at each time-step.

arxiv-2308-14409.title: Steerable Conditional Diffusion for Out-of-Distribution Adaptation in Medical Image Reconstruction
arxiv-2308-14409.creator: Riccardo Barbano, Alexander Denker, Hyungjin Chung, Tae Hoon Roh, Simon Arridge, Peter Maass, Bangti Jin, Jong Chul Ye
arxiv-2308-14409.description: Abstract Denoising diffusion models have emerged as the go-to generative framework for solving inverse problems in imaging. A critical concern regarding these models is their performance on out-of-distribution tasks, which remains an under-explored challenge. Using a diffusion model on an out-of-distribution dataset, realistic reconstructions can be generated, but with hallucinating image features that are uniquely present in the training dataset.

arxiv-2402-18422.title: Generalised Hydrodynamics description of the Page curve-like dynamics of a freely expanding fermionic gas
arxiv-2402-18422.creator: Madhumita Saha, Manas Kulkarni, Abhishek Dhar
arxiv-2402-18422.description: Abstract We consider an analytically tractable model that exhibits the main features of the Page curve characterizing the evolution of entanglement entropy during evaporation of a black hole. Our model is a gas of non-interacting fermions on a lattice that is released from a box into the vacuum.

arxiv-2406-17373.title: Covering B X B_{X} by finitely many convex sets
arxiv-2406-17373.creator: M. Raja
arxiv-2406-17373.description: Abstract Given a finite covering by closed convex sets of B X B_{X} , the unit ball of an infinite-dimensional Banach space, we investigate whether there is a set of the covering that contains balls of radius close to 1 1 and (a) arbitrarily high finite dimension or (b) infinite dimension.

arxiv-2407-19833.title: Revisiting the statistical equilibrium of H - in stellar atmospheres
arxiv-2407-19833.creator: Paul S. Barklem, Anish M. Amarsi
arxiv-2407-19833.description: Abstract The negative hydrogen ion H - is, almost without exception, treated in local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) in the modelling of F, G, and K stars, where it is the dominant opacity source in the visual spectral region. This assumption rests in practice on a study from the 1960s.

arxiv-2506-22655.title: Learning Stochastic Multiscale Models
arxiv-2506-22655.creator: Andrew F. Ilersich, Prasanth B. Nair
arxiv-2506-22655.description: Abstract The physical sciences are replete with dynamical systems that require the resolution of a wide range of length and time scales. This presents significant computational challenges since direct numerical simulation requires discretization at the finest relevant scales, leading to a high-dimensional state space.

arxiv-2509-00836.title: One-Step Model Predictive Path Integral for Manipulator Motion Planning Using Configuration Space Distance Fields
arxiv-2509-00836.creator: Yulin Li, Tetsuro Miyazaki, Kenji Kawashima
arxiv-2509-00836.description: Abstract Motion planning for robotic manipulators is a fundamental problem in robotics. Classical optimization-based methods typically rely on the gradients of signed distance fields (SDF) to impose collision-avoidance constraints. However, these methods are susceptible to local minima and may fail when the SDF gradients vanish.

arxiv-2509-19922.title: Phase Stability and Superconductivity in Hydrogenated and Lithiated Janus GaXS 2 (X = Ga, In) Monolayers.
arxiv-2509-19922.creator: Jakkapat Seeyangnok, Udomsilp Pinsook
arxiv-2509-19922.description: Abstract Hydrogen and lithium functionalization of two-dimensional (2D) materials offers a promising route to enhance electronic properties and induce superconductivity. Here, we employ first-principles calculations to explore the phase stability and superconducting behavior of hydrogenated and lithiated Janus GaXS 2 (X = Ga, In) monolayers.

arxiv-2509-20931.title: Reverse Faà di Bruno’s Formula for Cartesian Reverse Differential Categories
arxiv-2509-20931.creator: Aaron Biggin Jean-Simon Pacaud Lemay
arxiv-2509-20931.description: Abstract Reverse differentiation is an essential operation for automatic differentiation. Cartesian reverse differential categories axiomatize reverse differentiation in a categorical framework, where one of the primary axioms is the reverse chain rule, which is the formula that expresses the reverse derivative of a composition.

pmc-12496288.title: Verbal fluency dual-tasks show greater age-related cognitive-motor interference: a meta-analysis of walking performance
pmc-12496288.creator: Kenneth Harrison, Keven Santa-Maria Guzman, Brandon M. Peoples, Silvia Campos-Vargas, Bria R. Smith, Damaris C. Cifuentes, Grace Greer, Kristina A. Neely, Jaimie A. Roper
pmc-12496288.description: A substantial body of literature has examined gait during cognitive dual-tasking in younger and older adults. However, it remains unclear how, and to what extent, different cognitive tasks uniquely influence gait. This meta-analysis quantified age-related differences in gait speed during dual-task walking. Importantly, we examined cognitive task as a potential moderator.

pmc-12528457.title: Evaluation of seven Theobroma cacao clones grown in Terai region of India for nutritional composition and bioactive compounds
pmc-12528457.creator: Koyelika Deb, Shrilekha Das, P. S. Medda, A. K. Sit, S. Elain Apshara
pmc-12528457.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Analysis of biochemical composition along with the yield and morphological characteristics of cocoa clones provide a stronger base for identification of clones for commercial cultivation. Seven cocoa clones released from ICAR-CPCRI Research Station, Vittal, India, were evaluated for their morphological and biochemical quality parameters after processing, when cultivated in Terai region of West Bengal, India, being one of the non-traditional areas for cocoa cultivation having favourable soil and climatic conditions.

pmc-13410867.title: Integration of Transformer-Based Architecture and Large Language Models for Optical Coherence Tomography Data Analysis to Improve the Accuracy of Differential Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases
pmc-13410867.creator: OV Konshina, AD Pershin, MK Kulyabin, VI Borisov
pmc-13410867.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The aim of the present study was to improve the differential diagnosis accuracy of retinal diseases combining a transformer model to classify the biomarkers on OCT images and the large language model DeepSeek-V3.Materials and MethodsTwo datasets were collected and annotated: a training set (3288 central retinal OCT images annotated for 8 biomarkers) and a validation set (50 clinical cases from octcases.com). For biomarker classification, we compared ResNet, DenseNet, EfficientNet, and Vision Transformer (ViT-Tiny-Patch16-224) architectures.

pmc-13688954.title: Histology images in spatial transcriptomics: a critical evaluation of their effectiveness in spatial domain detection
pmc-13688954.creator: Abdullah Al Noman, Asif Ajrof, Md Abul Hassan Samee, M Saifur Rahman
pmc-13688954.description: MotivationSpatial transcriptomics (ST) has become a powerful tool for studying gene expression at the spatial level, as the position of a given spot provides crucial information about its phenotype. One key application of downstream analysis on these ST datasets is identifying spatial domains within tissue regions.
